'''Hapnix''' was a male [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] who was living in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] when the city was taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Hapnix was walking through the corridors with [[Lee Phenets]], [[Yoxgit/Legends|Yoxgit]], [[Grugnak]] and [[Ugloste/Legends|Ugloste]] when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] invited his guests to dine with him.
